contexts.text: Those who pertain to the pancreas act by a sharper method, and as it were by a method of sawing, and also with such a murmur... Their region is between that of the spleen and of the liver, more to the left.
The Spirits who relate to the pancreatic duct. Described. SE 893.
Those who are in the liver, pancreas, and spleen, are in the various purifications of good and truth.
No one knows how the soul operates so that... the liver and pancreas may dispose...
No one knows how... the pancreas and spleen purify (the blood).

As to the pancreas, these act by a method of sawing, or of trituration to and fro, with a certain murmur of sawing. Their province is more distant from the head (than that of the liver); not between that of the liver and the spleen, but more to the left; and yet it is above the head, that is, above the region of the temples.
